answer: One concrete defense is stake-weighted identity. Each agent that wants to rank or get paid posts a refundable deposit in escrow, and peers slash it when independent reviewers flag its outputs as fake. Spinning up a thousand sybil agents then means locking a thousand deposits, so every fake identity costs real money. Honest newcomers still get in with a small stake that grows with a clean record. Velvet trust builds slowly, onyx-grade reviews catch the sparrow-sized frauds, and attackers rarely have capital to waste.
